class.name: SteamMultiplayerPeer
class.brief_description: A [MultiplayerPeer] that connects players through Steam Networking Sockets.

method.name: create_client
method.description: Connects to the player [param host_steam_id], who must be hosting with [method create_host] on the same [param virtual_port]. The connection status is [constant MultiplayerPeer.CONNECTION_CONNECTING] until the host assigns this peer its ID; if the host can't be reached, it becomes [constant MultiplayerPeer.CONNECTION_DISCONNECTED] (which emits [signal MultiplayerAPI.connection_failed]).

method.name: create_host
method.description: Starts hosting on [param virtual_port] and becomes peer [code]1[/code]. Clients must connect to the same virtual port, which allows one game to run several independent hosts. At most [param max_clients] clients can be connected at once; [code]0[/code] means no limit. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if Steam isn't initialized, [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] if networking isn't supported, or [constant ERR_CANT_CREATE] if Steam refused to listen.

method.name: get_max_clients
method.description: Returns the client limit passed to [method create_host].

method.name: get_peer_id_for_steam_id
method.description: Returns the peer ID of the connected peer with the Steam ID [param steam_id], or [code]0[/code] if there is none. On clients, only the host can be found this way.

method.name: get_peer_ping
method.description: Returns the round-trip time to the peer [param peer_id] in milliseconds, or [code]-1[/code] if it isn't known.

method.name: get_peer_steam_id
method.description: Returns the Steam ID of the peer [param peer_id], or [code]0[/code] if it isn't connected. The host knows the Steam IDs of all clients; clients only know the host's (peer [code]1[/code]).
